entities.name: Roman Catholic Diocese of Goroka
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Diocese of Goroka is a Latin Catholic suffragan diocese of the Archdiocese of Mount Hagen, based in Goroka. It was erected Vicariate Apostolic in 1959 and elevated to a diocese in 1966. In 1982, part of the diocese was separated to become the Diocese of Kundiawa.
